fact: The Director-General of the Registos, Notariado e Identificação says the RNI services have a 100% computerised system in which all registry acts, including birth and death registrations, are drawn up electronically and signed by the conservators with a qualified electronic signature and time stamp.
title: Assinatura Electrónica já é uma realidade nos serviços dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação
